Add a site to a non-cooperating party

Source: R/sites_legacy.R
add_site.Rd

Part of the frozen Paillier-era legacy surface.

Usage

add_site(ncp, ...)

Arguments

ncp

an NCParty.

...

method-specific arguments. The NCParty method takes a single Site.

Value

the NCParty ncp, invisibly. Called for its side effect: the site is appended to the list of sites the party manages, held in its state environment.
